body: 2D anime vehicle illustration, NOT a photograph, NOT a photorealistic render -- flat digital cel-shaded artwork like a mobile-game vehicle icon or anime key-visual. Every surface is a FLAT solid color block with exactly 2-3 shading tones (base tone, one hard-edged shadow tone, one hard-edged highlight tone -- no smooth gradients, no photographic reflections, no chrome glossiness). A thick, bold, clean BLACK OUTLINE traces the entire silhouette and every panel seam, like a comic-book inked line. A neon-streetwear hover-car, NO WHEELS touching the ground -- instead it floats a visible gap above the floor on three glowing cyan #3de5ff repulsor-light pads underneath. Full clean 3/4-front reference view. A single dominant hue of hot magenta #ff2e88 as the main flat body-paint color, a lime #c6ff3d flat racing stripe down the side, chunky sneaker-sole-tread texture molded into the lower rocker panels as a pure style callback. Plain flat light-grey background, full vehicle visible front to back, no text, no logos, no driver, no watermark
